scientific_integrity: The semiaxes, volume profile, unique minimizer and d^(-1/4) law are proved analytically. The accompanying code offers finite corroboration only; the scientific review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional theorem for coordinate-symmetric single-slab truncations of the regular cross-polytope, d>=3 and 0<t<=1; not for other slabs or multicut bodies. The limit t->0 is a degenerating-body limit. Originality has residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Two sharp ellipsoid-contact transitions for symmetrically truncated cross-polytopes
